name: Recipe characterisation of the subsystem relation
description: Exercise 3.129: Z1 is a subsystem of Z2 if and only if there are coupling recipes SCR1, SCR2 with Z1 = RSY(SCR1), Z2 = RSY(SCR2), VSCR1 ⊆ VSCR2, and CSCR1 = CSCR2 restricted to the ports of VSCR1. The assertion holds.

elements.text: IsSubsystemOf Z1 Z2 ↔ ∃ recipes and an injective component embedding φ with Z1 = RSY(SCR1), Z2 = RSY(SCR2), and CSCR1 the restriction of CSCR2 to embedded ports.
